<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#08080C"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#08080C"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="21" y="20" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="12" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="10" x2="330" y2="18" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="8" x2="334" y2="18" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="17" x2="350" y2="17" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="8" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="10" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
  <rect x="383" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FAFAFD"/>
  
  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="45" width="38" height="38" rx="8" fill="#212131"/>
    <polyline points="40,56 31,64 40,72" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="72" y="69" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Transfer</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="331" y="45" width="41" height="38" rx="8" fill="#212131"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="62" r="2" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="62" r="2" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="62" r="2" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
    <text x="351" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">History</text>
  </g>

  <!-- tabs -->
  <rect x="18" y="101" width="354" height="43" rx="8" fill="#101018" stroke="#29293D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="20" y="103" width="173" height="39" rx="6" fill="#303045"/>
  <text x="106" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Send</text>
  <text x="280" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Receive</text>

  <!-- balance summary -->
  <text x="20" y="170" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Available to transfer</text>
  <text x="20" y="197" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="25px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">$12,480.62</text>
  <text x="173" y="197" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">USD</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="293" y="169" width="79" height="28" rx="6" fill="#212131" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="332" y="187" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">Max amount</text>
  </g>

  <!-- asset field -->
  <text x="20" y="226" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Asset</text>
  <rect x="18" y="234" width="354" height="57" rx="8" fill="#212131" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="262" r="16" fill="#7A57DD"/>
  <polygon points="44,247 36,262 44,258 52,262" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="44,260 36,264 44,277 52,264" fill="#C8C7D8"/>
  <text x="72" y="259" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Ethereum</text>
  <text x="72" y="277" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">ETH · Ethereum network</text>
  <polyline points="344,258 350,264 356,258" fill="none" stroke="#AFAEC0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- amount -->
  <text x="20" y="320" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Amount</text>
  <rect x="18" y="328" width="354" height="62" rx="8" fill="#212131" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="32" y="366" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">0.00</text>
  <text x="327" y="365" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">ETH</text>
  <line x1="300" y1="345" x2="300" y2="374" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="20" y="407" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Network fee is estimated at 0.0012 ETH</text>
  <text x="370" y="407" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#3ED9A4">≈ $0.00</text>

  <!-- recipient -->
  <text x="20" y="438" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Recipient wallet or account</text>
  <rect x="18" y="446" width="354" height="57" rx="8" fill="#212131" stroke="#38384D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="32" y="479" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">0x wallet address or username</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="329" y="458" width="31" height="32" rx="6" fill="#303045"/>
    <rect x="338" y="466" width="13" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="342,463 354,463 354,476" fill="none" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <text x="20" y="521" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Only send ETH to an Ethereum-compatible wallet.</text>

  <!-- review card -->
  <rect x="19" y="540" width="354" height="90" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.25"/>
  <rect x="18" y="538" width="354" height="90" rx="8" fill="#181825" stroke="#29293D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="32" y="562" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">Transfer details</text>
  <text x="32" y="586" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">You send</text>
  <text x="358" y="586" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">0.00 ETH</text>
  <line x1="32" y1="596" x2="358" y2="596" stroke="#29293D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="32" y="616" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Estimated arrival</text>
  <text x="358" y="616" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#3ED9A4">Within 2 minutes</text>

  <!-- primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="647" width="354" height="52" rx="6" fill="#3ED9A4" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="18" y="645" width="354" height="52" rx="6" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
    <text x="195" y="677" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#08080C">Review transfer</text>
    <polyline points="273,669 280,676 287,669" fill="none" stroke="#08080C" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="750" width="390" height="94" fill="#181825"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="750" x2="390" y2="750" stroke="#29293D" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- portfolio -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="763" width="62" height="35" rx="8" fill="#303045"/>
    <rect x="40" y="771" width="22" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="775" x2="59" y2="775" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="51" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Portfolio</text>
  </g>
  <!-- markets -->
  <g>
    <line x1="124" y1="783" x2="124" y2="772" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="131" y1="783" x2="131" y2="767" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="138" y1="783" x2="138" y2="775" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="131" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Markets</text>
  </g>
  <!-- alerts -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="220" cy="771" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="213" y="774" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="768" r="3" fill="#E45555"/>
    <text x="220" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Alerts</text>
  </g>
  <!-- profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="309" cy="770" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="309" cy="783" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="309" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="363" cy="775" r="3" fill="#6966FF"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="775" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="363" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
